en: Proverbs 14

p.src: 1  Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

en: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
u.src: 1  Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

p.src: 2  He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

en: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
u.src: 2  He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

p.src: 3  The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

en: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
u.src: 3  The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

p.src: 4  Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

en: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
u.src: 4  Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

p.src: 5  A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

en: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
u.src: 5  A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

p.src: 6  A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

en: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
u.src: 6  A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

p.src: 7  Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

en: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
u.src: 7  Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

p.src: 8  The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

en: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
u.src: 8  The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

p.src: 9  Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

en: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
u.src: 9  Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

p.src: 10  The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

en: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
u.src: 10  The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

p.src: 11  The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

en: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
u.src: 11  The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

p.src: 12  There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

en: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
u.src: 12  There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

p.src: 13  Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

en: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
u.src: 13  Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

p.src: 14  The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

en: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
u.src: 14  The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

p.src: 15  A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

en: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
u.src: 15  A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

p.src: 16  A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

en: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
u.src: 16  A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

p.src: 17  He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

en: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
u.src: 17  He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

p.src: 18  The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

en: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
u.src: 18  The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

p.src: 19  The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

en: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
u.src: 19  The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

p.src: 20  The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

en: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
u.src: 20  The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

p.src: 21  He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

en: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
u.src: 21  He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

p.src: 22  Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

en: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
u.src: 22  Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

p.src: 23  In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

en: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
u.src: 23  In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

p.src: 24  The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

en: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
u.src: 24  The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

p.src: 25  A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

en: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
u.src: 25  A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

p.src: 26  In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

en: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
u.src: 26  In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

p.src: 27  The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

en: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
u.src: 27  The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

p.src: 28  In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

en: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
u.src: 28  In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

p.src: 29  He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

en: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
u.src: 29  He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

p.src: 30  The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

en: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
u.src: 30  The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

p.src: 31  He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

en: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
u.src: 31  He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

p.src: 32  The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

en: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
u.src: 32  The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

p.src: 33  Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

en: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
u.src: 33  Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

p.src: 34  Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

en: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
u.src: 34  Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

p.src: 35  The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

en: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
u.src: 35  The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
